quests.title: Something For The Headaches
quests.description: Deliver 1 Fine-or-better Healing Draught to Mira so she can treat the town's growing wave of stress and sleepless pain.

completion_milestones.title: First Town Relief
completion_milestones.text: Mira's first delivered draught changed the conversation in the square. The tower is no longer just a ruin above town. It has begun helping again.

quests.title: A Safer Walk Home
quests.description: Deliver 1 Excellent Glow Potion with the soft_glow trait to Rowan so the darkening road home feels safe again.
quests.giver_intro_line: I work the cuttings after dark now. The beds do better when nothing is watching them, which is a stupid thing for a herbalist to say out loud. Bring me a light I can carry between the rows and I will stop saying it.
quests.giver_active_line: Any light yet? I have been counting the rows by touch and I keep getting a different number.

quests.title: The First Living Bed
quests.description: Deliver 1 Fine Glow Potion after the greenhouse opens so Brin can wake the old planter wards and give the town one reliable growing space again.

completion_milestones.title: Greenhouse Expanded
completion_milestones.text: Brin reset the old planter wards. A new moon bed is active on the north side of the greenhouse, and the town finally has reason to believe the valley can recover in more than scraps.

quests.title: For The Work Crews
quests.description: Deliver 1 Fine Stamina Tonic with the quickstep trait to Mayor Elric so the town crews can keep up repairs without collapsing early.

quests.title: Proof The Tower Once Healed
quests.description: Deliver 1 Star Lantern Elixir to Ione so she can prove the tower's old work reached beyond its own walls.

quests.title: Gentle Habitats
quests.description: Deliver 1 Beastcalm Extract so Lyra can tune the habitat wards and begin steadying the valley's unsettled small creatures.

completion_milestones.title: Habitats Stabilized
completion_milestones.text: Lyra tuned the habitat wards. Gentle collection from tower creatures can now support regular alchemical work.

quests.giver_intro_line: The small creatures are changing their habits. Fewer pollinators, stranger nesting, too much fear where there used to be routine. Give me something calm enough to tune the wards with and we shelter them properly, rather than trapping them and calling it help.
quests.giver_active_line: Calm, and it has to carry light. I am not putting anything sharp near them while they are already frightened.

quests.title: The Beds That Will Not Take
quests.description: Deliver 1 Fine-or-better Purified Draught to Rowan so she can flush the seed trays and find out whether the fault is in the seed or in the ground under it.
quests.giver_intro_line: Now that I can see them, I wish I could not. Four trays sown the same week and not one of them has taken. I need something clean enough to flush the trays without leaving its own residue behind — then at least I will know whether to blame the seed or the ground.
quests.giver_active_line: The trays are waiting. Nothing clever, mind. Clean. Whatever you bring me becomes part of the answer, so it had better not be part of the question.

completion_milestones.title: The Fault Is In The Ground
completion_milestones.text: Rowan's flushed trays came up as empty as the sown ones. The seed is sound. Whatever is failing in the valley is failing underneath it, in ground the town has worked the same way for four generations.

quests.title: What The Valley Used To Grow
quests.description: Deliver 2 Fine-or-better Verdant Restoratives to Rowan so the bed rows behind the square can be turned and fed properly for the first time in years.
quests.giver_intro_line: The ground, then. It has been asked for a harvest every year and offered nothing back since before my mother had the stall. Two restoratives, properly made, and I will turn the whole bed row myself. If it works we stop buying our own herbs from the road traders.
quests.giver_active_line: Two of them, and neither one thin. I only get to turn those beds once this season — if the second is weaker than the first I will have wasted the row and the year with it.

completion_milestones.title: The Bed Rows Turned
completion_milestones.text: Rowan worked the restorative into the bed rows behind the square and had the whole row turned before evening. Within days there was moss on the north wall again and bloom along the path. The town square grows its own for the first time in a decade.

quests.title: Count What Is Still Flying
quests.description: Deliver 2 Fine-or-better Mothlight Brews so Lyra can mark the bloom rows after dark and count what still comes to them.
quests.giver_intro_line: The wards hold and nothing is breeding. Sheltered, fed, safe, and not one new brood since I opened the floor. I need to know whether that is happening out in the valley too, and I cannot count what I cannot see. Two mothlight brews. I will mark the bloom rows and sit with them after dark.
quests.giver_active_line: Two, so I can mark two rows and compare them. One row on its own tells me a number. Two tells me whether the number means anything.

completion_milestones.title: The Count Is Taken
completion_milestones.text: Lyra sat two marked bloom rows for four nights and counted eleven visitors where her predecessor's log recorded ninety. The collapse is not in the tower's habitats. It is the whole valley, and the habitats were only where it became impossible to ignore.

quests.title: Something Worth Coming Back For
quests.description: Deliver 1 Excellent-or-better Bloomrise Elixir so Lyra can work a full season of flowering into the valley's bloom rows at once.
quests.giver_intro_line: Eleven where there were ninety. They did not die, they left, because there was nothing here worth the trip. So we give them one. A bloomrise elixir, and I mean a real one, worked into the rows all at once so the whole valley flowers in the same week. Either they come back for that or they do not come back at all.
quests.giver_active_line: It has to be a morph, and it has to be excellent. Anything less and the bloom is a week early and a week thin, and I have spent my one chance at it.

completion_milestones.title: The Valley Flowers At Once
completion_milestones.text: Every bloom row in the valley opened inside four days. By the end of the week Lyra had stopped counting visitors and started counting broods. The habitats have a third occupant now, and the wild rows have more bloom than anyone alive has walked through.
